title: Bounds on Odd and Odd-Even Induced Subgraphs
summary: Let $G$ be an $n$-vertex graph and let $\ell:V(G)\to\mathbb{F}_2$ prescribe degree parities. A set $S\subseteq V(G)$ is $\ell$-admissible if every $v\in S$ has degree congruent to $\ell(v)$ modulo $2$ in $G[S]$. Let $h_\ell(G)$ be the maximum order of an $\ell$-admissible set, set $f_{\mathrm{oe}}(G):=\min_\ell h_\ell(G)$, and write $f_o(G):=h_{\mathbf{1}}(G)$, where $\mathbf{1}(v)=1$ for every $v\in V(G).$ We prove three main results for graphs without isolated vertices.
